---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for FoodRater
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: []
---

## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to add.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why would it be useful?

## 📋 Proposed Solution
Detailed description of how you want this feature to work.

## 🎨 UI/UX Design (if applicable)
Mockups or design ideas for how this should look and feel.

## 🔄 Workflow Description
How would a user interact with this feature?

## 📊 Priority Assessment
- **Impact**: How many users would benefit? (High/Medium/Low)
- **Complexity**: How complex is this to implement? (High/Medium/Low)
- **Priority**: Overall priority (High/Medium/Low)

## 🚀 Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.
